newsitem.title: FRANCE: Centeon resumes production after recall.
newsitem.headline: Centeon resumes production after recall.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer said in a statement on Friday its Centeon LCC joint venture with Hoechst AG had restarted production at its Kankakee plant after signing a protocol with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

Centeon LCC on October 10 recalled its in-date lots of albumin products as a precaution against risks of bacterial infection. Centeon said it had made a number of modifications to its production and control processes.
At the time, Rhone-Poulenc finance director Jean-Pierre Tirouflet expected the total impact of the recall to be between 100 and 200 million francs in 1996.
Rhone-Poulenc is the controlling shareholder of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer.
